title: WebGPU 3D Text Mesh in Rust and wgpu
description: Build 3D text from font outlines in Rust and wgpu. Learn RTL shaping, Bézier curve sampling, extrusion, indexed meshes, and WGSL lighting with WebGPU.
imageAlt: Gold Hey WGPU! lettering above blue Persian text, with extruded contour strokes and visible side faces on a dark background.
